item.title: 🟠 Critical TeamCity Flaw Could Let Attackers Run OS Commands Without Logging In
item.description:

item.description:

item.title: 🟠 Microsoft Says New Cybersecurity AI Model Helps MDASH Score 95.95% at Half the Cost
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Microsoft has launched its first cybersecurity-specific model inside MDASH, its multi-model vulnerability identification and remediation harness. The company says MDASH, using MAI-Cyber-1-Flash and GPT-5.4, scored 95.95% on CyberGym.
